title: Gronin playbook guard block
description: The value that replaces the reserved `guard` property of specs/001-runtime-core/contracts/playbook.schema.json when this feature lands; until then that schema refuses the block outright. Shape only, like the playbook schema: the durations of the claim set belong to the deployment and are checked by the runtime at startup, not here. An unknown key is refused (FR-119).

runs.description: At most this many runs start within any window of `per` (FR-114). A run counts from the moment it starts, whatever its outcome.

per.description: The window, in whole minutes or hours. Keyed on the playbook name alone.

rate.description: A trigger this refuses is discarded, never made to wait (FR-116).

wait.description: How long a trigger refused because the playbook is already running may wait for it (FR-112). 0s refuses it at once, recorded as expired.
